${modID}:Diminish.NAME: Diminish
${modID}:Diminish.DESCRIPTION: If target has ${modID}:Omen NL Apply !M! Weak NL Apply !M! Vulnerable NL Remove 1 ${modID}:Omen

${modID}:ConjureWounds.NAME: Conjure Wounds
${modID}:ConjureWounds.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage for each ${modID}:Omen on the target NL Remove ${modID}:Omen from target

${modID}:AbruptPain.NAME: Abrupt Pain
${modID}:AbruptPain.DESCRIPTION: If target has ${modID}:Omen, deal !D! damage. NL Remove 1 ${modID}:Omen

${modID}:ScornfulRetreat.NAME: Scornful Retreat
${modID}:ScornfulRetreat.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block NL Apply !M! ${modID}:Omen to an enemy

${modID}:NegativeEnergy.NAME: Negative Energy
${modID}:NegativeEnergy.DESCRIPTION: For every !M! debuffs on ALL combatants, gain [E]

${modID}:WaveOfLethargy.NAME: Wave of Lethargy
${modID}:WaveOfLethargy.DESCRIPTION: ALL combatants with at least 2 ${modID}:Omen NL Lose !M! Strength this turn NL Gain !M! Weak NL Lose 2 ${modID}:Omen

${modID}:LifeTransference.NAME: Life Transference
${modID}:LifeTransference.DESCRIPTION: ALL enemies lose HP equal to their ${modID}:Omen, Then lose all ${modID}:Omen. Heal HP equal to damage. NL Exhaust
${modID}:LifeTransference.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: ALL enemies lose HP equal to their ${modID}:Omen, Then lose half ${modID}:Omen. Heal HP equal to damage. NL Exhaust

${modID}:DawnOfCalamity.NAME: Dawn of Calamity
${modID}:DawnOfCalamity.DESCRIPTION: Apply !M! ${modID}:Omen to ALL combatants. NL Exhaust

${modID}:ExpelSoul.NAME: Expel Soul
${modID}:ExpelSoul.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage to a random enemy for each debuff you have. NL Remove ALL debuffs

${modID}:NarrowVision.NAME: Narrow Vision
${modID}:NarrowVision.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards NL Gain [E] [E] NL Whenever you play a card this turn, lose 1 HP
${modID}:NarrowVision.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards NL Gain [E] [E] [E] NL Whenever you play a card this turn, lose 1 HP

${modID}:Overextension.NAME: Overextension
${modID}:Overextension.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage twice NL Apply 1 Vulnerable to yourself

${modID}:SomberMemories.NAME: Somber Memories
${modID}:SomberMemories.DESCRIPTION: ALL combatants take 10% extra damage per card played each turn

${modID}:MaskThePain.NAME: Mask The Pain
${modID}:MaskThePain.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you gain a debuff, gain !M! Block.
